summary: All three requested frontend requirements appear to be implemented: gameplay is blocked when offline with a blocking overlay and resumes on reconnect (REQ-10), the service worker is adjusted to avoid caching game assets while still serving offline.html for navigation failures (REQ-11), and the Help/About content now explicitly states that an internet connection is required and offline play is not supported (REQ-12). No unrequested features are clearly introduced in the provided diff summary.
